summary: Iteration 6 — user-reported bugs (BUG1 'how you choose' on all four instruments, BUG2 cross-check richness with agreements + synthesis, BUG3 item interleaving). Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py — 18 pytest tests, all passing. Full backend regression: 104/104 pytest tests (86 pre-existing + 18 new), tests/test_locked_copy.py → LOCKED COPY OK, tests/_e2e_test.py → PACKAGED E2E OK. UI verification on ui.demo@ratherknow.com (all 4 instruments completed): /mirrors renders mirrors-synthesis + mirrors-synthesis-body (quoting Delta 8.2, sten values, domain scores) and 3 mirrors-agreement-N cards labelled 'Agreement' (Closeness×Personality → settled, Essential×Personality → close, EI×Essential → attunement); no 'No tensions worth reporting'-only page. Each of the 4 result pages (eq, personality, essential, closeness) renders choosing-section + choosing-title + 2–5 choosing-point-* items with instrument-specific real numbers.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/choosing.py — clean read-time derivation. _essential picks the two most-different archetypes (wants_more/already_is) and quotes overall Delta with situation-appropriate copy; _closeness gates on dimension.status=='scored' before quoting values, so invalidated closeness never gets fabricated numbers; _personality bounds high@sten>=7 and low@sten<=4 with a graceful fallback when nothing crosses; _eq quotes overall_score>=4.0 with the 'high read is not good choosing' caveat. build_choosing returns None cleanly on any KeyError/TypeError, so a malformed snapshot cannot crash /result. Points are capped at 5. CLOSING is a single fixed string.

backend/crosscheck.py — AGREE_BAND 0.14 and TENSION_BAND 0.30 are conservative (there is a 0.14–0.30 dead-zone where nothing fires, which is exactly right for 'honesty'). _readings normalises everything with a clamp so out-of-range never propagates. Two-key alias ('MI-AS-36' or 'closeness') is handled once at the top so callers can pass either. self_reliance construct is included in CONSTRUCT_COPY but its agree/tension bodies are empty strings, and both loops skip early — deliberate: personality Q2 doesn't have an obvious cross-instrument twin. build_synthesis returns None with <2 instruments (contract with /mirrors and combined PDF); every value it prints is quoted from the source dict.

routes/mirror_v2.py::_spread — deterministic round-robin with rotating offset. Because it is called from _build_items which is pure (reads bank + constants, no random.seed), the resume order is identical to the start order. Scoring keys on item ID rather than position, so interleaving cannot affect scores. Confirmed by test_bug3_order_stable_on_resume across personality/eq/essential. Closeness is deliberately untouched (uses bank['order']).

routes/mirror_v2.py::_with_choosing — applied at every read (complete + result). The 'choosing' key is never persisted: verified in test_bug1_choosing_not_stored_in_snapshot by reading mirror_v2_sessions.result and results.result directly from Mongo. Immutability guarantee preserved.

routes/mirror_v2.py::/mirrors/findings — now returns findings + agreements + synthesis in one shot. With len(by_instrument) < 2 it explicitly returns [] / [] / None, so the frontend's one-instrument case is safe.

report_pdf.py::_choosing_block — renders 'How you choose' as h2 + lead + point titles/bodies + closing in both build_report_pdf and build_combined_pdf. Combined PDF also prints the synthesis (title + body + footnote) and AGREEMENT/FINDING labelled entries. Verified with pymupdf substring assertions.

frontend/src/pages/Mirrors.js — mirrors-synthesis dark card + mirrors-agreements grid + mirrors-more-instruments hint present; agreements labelled 'Agreement', tensions labelled 'Finding' via kicker. With 4 completed the more-instruments hint is not rendered (verified: count 0). With 1 completed no cross-check block at all (test_bug2_no_crosscheck_with_one_instrument asserts empty payload).

frontend/src/components/ChoosingSection.js — renders on all result pages when result.choosing is present; data-testid choosing-section / choosing-title / choosing-point-N are all present and counted on live preview for eq (3 pts), personality (2 pts), essential (5 pts), closeness (3 pts).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (mirrors synthesis+agreements + 4 result pages verified on live preview with ui.demo)

test_credentials: ui.demo@ratherknow.com / knowmore123 (all 4 instruments completed) — used for UI verification. Iteration 6 tests create ~5 throwaway TEST_it6_* users per run.
seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed TEST_it6_*, deterministic per-session seeding. No production seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration6.py adds 18 tests: BUG3 adjacency (personality across 15 factors, eq across sub, essential per-lens category, closeness spec order preserved with first ids 34,28,15,27,22, order stable on resume via GET), BUG1 choosing block on complete+result endpoints for all four instruments with real-number quotes and forbidden-term guard (verdicts/clinical/predictions), immutability check reading mongo directly, per-result and combined PDF contain 'How you choose', BUG2 findings endpoint returns synthesis+agreements+findings with 4 instruments, agreements only <=0.14 apart, tensions only >=0.30 apart, no cross-check with 1 instrument, combined PDF contains 'How you choose — the short version' + AGREEMENT/FINDING entries. Note about the personality item stream: total_items in INSTRUMENTS meta is 130 (personality items only) but _build_items returns 130 + 8 validity items interleaved — the adjacency test looks at the personality-only sub-sequence because validity items act as spacers. Also note that load_dotenv must load both /app/frontend/.env AND /app/backend/.env (for MONGO_URL) — the test file does this explicitly.
